roles.title: Mechanical design and prototyping

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Create and revise drawings or a digital model.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Choose materials and dimensions for the intended conditions.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Compare the prototype with its requirements and refine the design.

roles.summary: Translate a need into a component or machine that can be built and tested. Designers use dimensions, material properties and constraints to evaluate alternatives.

roles.title: Manufacturing and quality work

tasks.title: Read
tasks.detail: Read a drawing or work instruction before setting up a task.

tasks.title: Measure
tasks.detail: Measure key dimensions or properties and record the result.

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Investigate variation rather than treating every difference as acceptable.

roles.summary: Make repeatable components and check that the output matches a specification.

roles.title: Quality and traceability

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Check that materials and samples have traceable identities.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Compare recorded results with defined acceptance criteria.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Investigate deviations and document what changed.

roles.summary: Make it possible to explain how a result or product was produced. Quality work checks records, methods and acceptance criteria so variation can be investigated rather than hidden.

pathwayCandidates.name: Learning through retail and production experience

roles.title: Instrumentation and controls

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Check whether sensors are reading reliably.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Compare measurements with the intended operating range.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Test how the system responds to a change or fault.

roles.summary: Keep a process measurable and responsive. Controls work connects sensors, decisions and actuators so the system can respond when conditions change.

roles.title: Software and data systems

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Translate a user need into a testable behaviour.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Build and test a data-processing or display feature.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Investigate failures and document assumptions about inputs.

roles.summary: Build the tools that move, process and display information. Reliable software needs testing against missing, delayed and unexpected data as well as ideal examples.

roles.title: Technical application support

tasks.title: Ask
tasks.detail: Ask what the user is trying to measure or control.

tasks.title: Separate
tasks.detail: Separate a setup problem from a sensor or process problem.

tasks.title: Explain
tasks.detail: Explain the next diagnostic step and record what changed.

roles.summary: Help people use a technical product in the conditions of their own workplace.

roles.title: Materials research and testing

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Prepare comparable samples with and without an additive.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Measure a relevant property under consistent conditions.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Explain performance changes alongside uncertainty and practical constraints.

roles.summary: Investigate whether a material improves a product for a defined purpose. A useful comparison separates the effect of the added material from other changes in the test.

roles.title: Laboratory analysis

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Prepare and label samples so their identity is preserved.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Run comparisons or reference samples to check the method.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Record results, units and limitations before sharing findings.

roles.summary: Make measurements that other people can trust. A laboratory worker prepares samples, uses a method consistently and records enough detail for someone else to interpret the result.

roles.title: Dispatch and logistics coordination

tasks.title: Match
tasks.detail: Match deliveries or orders with available capacity.

tasks.title: Check
tasks.detail: Check timing, identification and handling requirements.

tasks.title: Respond
tasks.detail: Respond to a delay without losing track of the product or customer need.

roles.summary: Keep materials moving in the right order, with the information needed at each handoff.

roles.title: Diagnostic medical sonographer

tasks.title: Prepare
tasks.detail: Prepare for the requested examination and communicate with the patient.

tasks.title: Position
tasks.detail: Position the transducer and adjust acquisition settings to obtain useful views.

tasks.title: Document
tasks.detail: Document the images for interpretation within the clinical team's workflow.

roles.summary: Acquire ultrasound images while supporting the person being examined.

roles.title: Medical office and booking support

tasks.title: Handle
tasks.detail: Handle appointment requests and confirm required information.

tasks.title: Communicate
tasks.detail: Communicate clearly with patients and modality teams.

tasks.title: Keep
tasks.detail: Keep registration and scheduling records accurate.

roles.summary: Help patients and clinical teams coordinate the information and appointments needed for care.

pathwayCandidates.name: Medical Office Assistant and Unit Clerk

roles.title: Bootmaking and pattern work

tasks.title: Plan
tasks.detail: Plan and cut pieces with attention to material stretch.

tasks.title: Join
tasks.detail: Join and shape components through stitching and lasting.

tasks.title: Inspect
tasks.detail: Inspect the finished result against the intended design and fit.

roles.summary: Translate a design and material choice into a pair of boots through skilled craft.

pathwayCandidates.name: Learning through retail and production experience

roles.title: Acoustical consulting

tasks.title: Measure
tasks.detail: Measure or model sound paths and levels.

tasks.title: Compare
tasks.detail: Compare changes to room surfaces, layout or noise isolation.

tasks.title: Explain
tasks.detail: Explain the trade-offs to the people designing or using the space.

roles.summary: Investigate how sound behaves in a space and recommend changes for its intended use.

roles.title: Process and plant operations

tasks.title: Monitor the process
tasks.detail: Take readings and inspect equipment for signs of unusual behaviour.

tasks.title: Keep useful records
tasks.detail: Document conditions and events so results can be compared across shifts and tests.

tasks.title: Troubleshoot safely
tasks.detail: Report problems, support maintenance and help with commissioning or start-up work.

roles.summary: Keep processing equipment running safely and learn from its measurements.

roles.title: Refrigeration and air-conditioning mechanic

tasks.title: Use
tasks.detail: Use drawings to locate components and controls.

tasks.title: Check
tasks.detail: Check operating conditions and investigate a fault.

tasks.title: Repair
tasks.detail: Repair or adjust equipment and verify the result.

roles.summary: Install, maintain and troubleshoot equipment that moves heat and conditions air.

roles.title: Warehouse and inventory operations

tasks.title: Check
tasks.detail: Check incoming goods against shipment information.

tasks.title: Move
tasks.detail: Move and store products using appropriate equipment and procedures.

tasks.title: Maintain
tasks.detail: Maintain inventory records and coordinate outbound loads.

roles.summary: Receive, locate and move goods while keeping identity and handling requirements visible.

roles.title: Process engineering

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Draw a flow of materials and energy through the system.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Compare operating conditions and equipment options.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Use trial results to revise the process and communicate constraints.

roles.summary: Turn a useful transformation into a workable sequence of equipment and operating steps. Process engineers consider what enters, what leaves and what conditions the system must maintain.

roles.title: Landscape design

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Read the site and identify competing needs.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Develop plans and sections that show landforms and planting.

tasks.title: Document and improve
tasks.detail: Review details with engineers, ecologists and construction teams.

roles.summary: Shape outdoor spaces so water, habitat and human uses can work together.

roles.title: Spatial data and mapping

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Check coordinate systems and measurement dates.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Align and inspect spatial datasets.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Present maps or models with their limitations.

roles.summary: Turn measurements tied to places into usable spatial information. The work involves coordinates, scale and checking that datasets describe the same location and time.

roles.title: Environmental field assessment

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Plan observations or samples around a clear question.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Record locations, methods and conditions consistently.

tasks.title: Document and improve
tasks.detail: Explain the limits of the evidence and the next useful check.

roles.summary: Collect and interpret evidence about a place before recommending an action.

roles.title: Structural engineering

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Identify loads and constraints in the design brief.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Develop and check a structural model and details.

tasks.title: Document and improve
tasks.detail: Coordinate construction-stage requirements with the project team.

roles.summary: Work out how a structure transfers loads through members and connections to its supports.

roles.title: Civil and construction technology

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Prepare technical drawings using measured site information.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Check dimensions and interfaces between design disciplines.

tasks.title: Document and improve
tasks.detail: Support construction records and field verification.

roles.summary: Turn project requirements into usable drawings, quantities and checks.

roles.title: Construction coordination

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Track design changes and unresolved interfaces.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Compare construction stages with access and operating constraints.

tasks.title: Document and improve
tasks.detail: Communicate decisions and confirm that the correct documents reach the field.

roles.summary: Help different teams work from compatible information and an achievable sequence.

roles.title: Roast production

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Track batch identity and process settings.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Record observations and measurements during production.

tasks.title: Document and improve
tasks.detail: Report variation and help compare trial adjustments.

roles.summary: Operate a controlled food-processing sequence and compare the product with its intended result.

roles.title: Instrument development and testing

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Check performance using a known reference.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Investigate drift, noise or inconsistent readings.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Document tests so later users know what the instrument can establish.

roles.summary: Help build and check the equipment that produces measurements. Instrument work joins hardware, software and experiments rather than treating a reading as automatically correct.

roles.title: Storyboarding and illustration

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Translate a message into visual scenes.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Check order, viewpoint and transitions using rough drawings.

tasks.title: Document and improve
tasks.detail: Revise the sequence after feedback before detailed animation.

roles.summary: Decide what an audience needs to see before the final sequence is produced.

roles.title: Animation

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Set key positions and the time between them.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Adjust spacing and transitions to communicate movement.

tasks.title: Document and improve
tasks.detail: Review the result against the story and technical requirements.

roles.summary: Create motion from planned images, models and timing decisions.

roles.title: Creative production coordination

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Clarify audience, scope and review milestones.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Coordinate feedback between creative and client teams.

tasks.title: Document and improve
tasks.detail: Track revisions and confirm delivery requirements.

roles.summary: Help a project move from a communication brief to a deliverable that can be reviewed.

roles.title: Rail traffic control

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Monitor movement information and operating constraints.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Coordinate plans and communicate with railway teams.

tasks.title: Document and improve
tasks.detail: Respond to changes using the applicable procedures and authority.

roles.summary: Coordinate railway movements and crews within formal operating systems and rules.

roles.title: Railway conductor work

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Apply operating procedures during assigned movements.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Communicate with other railway workers.

tasks.title: Document and improve
tasks.detail: Check and document required operational information.

roles.summary: Support train movements and handling of rail vehicles through trained railway operations.

roles.title: Water-resource planning

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Organize supply, use and monitoring information.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Test alternative assumptions in scenarios.

tasks.title: Document and improve
tasks.detail: Explain trade-offs, uncertainty and priorities.

roles.summary: Compare water availability, demand and possible responses over time.

roles.title: Planning communication and engagement

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Explain scenarios and technical options in accessible language.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Gather and document questions and priorities.

tasks.title: Document and improve
tasks.detail: Make clear what the evidence supports and where choices remain.

roles.summary: Help people with different needs understand and contribute to a planning process.

roles.title: Water-treatment operations

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Monitor process readings and output tests.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Follow operating and maintenance procedures.

tasks.title: Document and improve
tasks.detail: Document deviations and coordinate investigation.

roles.summary: Keep a treatment process working within its specified conditions and record how it performs.

roles.title: Building-science investigation

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Inspect conditions and record where problems appear.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Compare observations with drawings and possible movement paths.

tasks.title: Document and improve
tasks.detail: Help develop and verify repairs with the design team.

roles.summary: Investigate how a building enclosure manages heat, air and water.

roles.title: Commercial baking

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Follow recipes and production schedules.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Use and check production equipment within trained procedures.

tasks.title: Document and improve
tasks.detail: Observe product consistency and communicate defects or process variation.

roles.summary: Produce baked goods through a controlled sequence of preparation, processing and handling.

roles.title: Camera and image capture

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Plan framing and camera setup with the production team.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Check exposure and consistency across takes.

tasks.title: Document and improve
tasks.detail: Record information needed for editing and handoff.

roles.summary: Record images that serve a production’s visual and storytelling requirements.

roles.title: Film and video editing

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Review and organize available footage.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Choose cuts, order and timing for the intended story.

tasks.title: Document and improve
tasks.detail: Check continuity and revise against feedback.

roles.summary: Build a sequence from selected footage to communicate a coherent idea.

roles.title: Colour finishing

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Compare shots using the agreed visual reference.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Adjust recorded colour and tonal relationships.

tasks.title: Document and improve
tasks.detail: Check the sequence and deliverable with the production team.

roles.summary: Work on the appearance and consistency of images during post-production.

roles.title: Ingredient and formulation science

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Choose a property to compare across formulations.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Prepare controlled trials and observe changes over time.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Explain the trade-offs between ingredients and processing conditions.

roles.summary: Investigate how ingredients behave in a product. This work connects a material’s composition to properties such as texture, stability or performance in a mixture.

roles.title: Scientific applications

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Choose a measurement approach for the sample.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Compare outputs with reference information.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Explain what further tests would resolve ambiguity.

roles.summary: Connect an instrument to the question a user needs to answer. Applications work involves selecting a method, interpreting results and explaining limitations.

roles.title: Machining and dimensional inspection

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Interpret a drawing and plan a sequence of cuts.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Set up the machine and check the workpiece.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Measure critical dimensions and document deviations.

roles.summary: Make parts fit their intended purpose by controlling dimensions. Machining combines tools, setup and measurement; finishing a part is not the same as proving it meets its specification.

roles.title: Aircraft maintenance

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Inspect a component using the applicable procedure.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Compare findings with documented limits and escalate uncertainty.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Record work and test results for the maintenance decision.

roles.summary: Investigate condition, carry out authorized maintenance and preserve the records behind a decision. Aircraft maintenance work relies on approved procedures and appropriate qualifications.

roles.title: Avionics and electronics

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Trace a signal through connected components.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Use test equipment to compare expected and measured behaviour.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Document the fault and verify the result after authorized work.

roles.summary: Work on the electronic systems that allow aircraft to communicate, navigate and collect data. Troubleshooting means distinguishing a faulty sensor from wiring, power or software problems.

roles.title: Bioprocess development

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Define a comparison between process conditions.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Track production and purification steps for each batch.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Use analytical results to decide which change to test next.

roles.summary: Develop repeatable ways to make and purify biological materials. This work connects molecular science to manufacturing conditions and checks whether a change improves the process.

roles.title: Drone operations

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Review the task, site and operating constraints.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Check the aircraft and coordinate the flight with relevant personnel.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Record observations and equipment issues after the flight.

roles.summary: Plan and carry out flights for a specific task while coordinating with the people responsible for the site. The aircraft is one tool within an operational plan.

roles.title: Wildlife monitoring and interpretation

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Define how bird activity will be counted.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Compare observations before and after an intervention.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Record weather, season and other factors that could explain a difference.

roles.summary: Observe how animals respond to an intervention and ask whether the change lasts. This work needs consistent observations and attention to other causes of changing behaviour.

roles.title: Geoscience and interpretation

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Describe core and identify changes along it.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Compare sensor patterns with geological observations or assays.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Communicate alternative interpretations and uncertainty.

roles.summary: Explain what rock measurements suggest about geology. Geoscientists combine observations with context and use additional tests where a scan leaves uncertainty.

roles.title: Industrial machinery assembly and maintenance

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Read equipment drawings and plan assembly steps.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Align and connect mechanical components.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Check operation and record problems that need adjustment.

roles.summary: Make machinery work together as a physical system. Millwright work connects assembly, alignment, inspection and troubleshooting.

roles.title: Metal fabrication and welding

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Read dimensions and prepare components.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Use the specified joining process and sequence.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Inspect the assembly and communicate any deviation.

roles.summary: Join and assemble material into usable structures. Fabrication work follows drawings and procedures, then checks whether the finished work meets its requirements.

roles.title: Power-electronics design

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Choose and document a circuit design.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Test its response across operating conditions.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Investigate losses and component limits before revising the design.

roles.summary: Control how electrical energy moves between components. Power-electronics work combines circuit design with testing, thermal limits and the behaviour of the complete system.

roles.title: Weather-data interpretation

tasks.title: Investigate
tasks.detail: Check the position, time and quality of observations.

tasks.title: Test and compare
tasks.detail: Compare measurements across altitude or time.

tasks.title: Explain and improve
tasks.detail: Identify gaps and explain how they limit an interpretation.

roles.summary: Use observations to understand changing atmospheric conditions. Weather-data work checks where and when a measurement was made before combining it with other evidence.

roles.title: Conservation research and population ecology

tasks.title: Plan a comparison
tasks.detail: Choose measures of survival, breeding and population change, and decide what to compare them with.

tasks.title: Follow animals after release
tasks.detail: Record observations over time, accounting for animals that are difficult to detect.

tasks.title: Interpret the evidence
tasks.detail: Ask whether results reflect the intervention, environmental conditions or other explanations.

roles.summary: Find out whether an intervention helps a wild population recover.

roles.title: Animal care and welfare

tasks.title: Provide daily care
tasks.detail: Follow prescribed diets and maintain clean, suitable habitats.

tasks.title: Observe and record
tasks.detail: Track behaviour, weight and body condition, and report changes to the team.

tasks.title: Work with specialists
tasks.detail: Support veterinary procedures and enrichment under established welfare and safety protocols.

roles.summary: Support animals day to day and notice changes that matter.

roles.title: Veterinary care for wildlife

tasks.title: Assess health
tasks.detail: Examine animals and interpret observations or diagnostic tests.

tasks.title: Plan treatment
tasks.detail: Choose appropriate care and work with the animal-care team to monitor the response.

tasks.title: Support conservation decisions
tasks.detail: Contribute health and welfare evidence to decisions about care, transport and release.

roles.summary: Assess animal health and support safe care and release.

roles.title: Process engineering

tasks.title: Compare separation steps
tasks.detail: Evaluate how different treatment stages affect recovery, purity and resource use.

tasks.title: Check the balances
tasks.detail: Account for material entering and leaving each stage, using models and measurements.

tasks.title: Test and improve
tasks.detail: Use pilot or demonstration results to improve designs and support commissioning.

roles.summary: Design and test the steps that separate useful materials from a mixture.

roles.title: Atmospheric science and remote sensing

tasks.title: Check the signal
tasks.detail: Decide whether a measurement is reliable, or caused by something else such as cloud or a bright surface.

tasks.title: Build an estimate
tasks.detail: Use models and wind information to turn an absorption signal into a rate of emission.

tasks.title: Share the findings
tasks.detail: Explain results, and their uncertainty, to people who make decisions.

roles.summary: Turn light measurements into an explanation of what is in the air.

roles.title: Satellite and instrument engineering

tasks.title: Design the instrument
tasks.detail: Choose optics and detectors that can pick out the wavelengths methane absorbs.

tasks.title: Test and calibrate
tasks.detail: Check on the ground that the instrument measures what it should, using known light sources.

tasks.title: Support it in orbit
tasks.detail: Monitor performance after launch and help fix problems from the ground.

roles.summary: Design, build and test the instruments and spacecraft that take the measurements.

roles.title: Software and data

tasks.title: Build data pipelines
tasks.detail: Process large numbers of observations reliably and quickly.

tasks.title: Build tools for users
tasks.detail: Create web platforms and interfaces that let customers find and use results.

tasks.title: Find patterns
tasks.detail: Use statistics and machine learning to sort sites and spot changes over time.

roles.summary: Turn satellite measurements into data and tools people can use.

roles.title: Business development and partnerships

tasks.title: Understand the need
tasks.detail: Identify customer problems and assess whether the technology can help.

tasks.title: Build a proposal
tasks.detail: Translate scientific capabilities into a clear offer, coordinating technical and commercial contributions.

tasks.title: Coordinate delivery
tasks.detail: Maintain relationships and track the commitments made in a contract.

roles.summary: Connect technical capabilities with the people who can use them.
